config.batching: Original eval_batch_size and original seen-test row order per checkpoint

policies.granularity: One saved state after each complete task. No initial/epoch/optimizer-step weights are available; no within-task flip time, cause or learning-then-forgetting claim is identifiable.
policies.json_samples: All six Infiltration probe indices; first three ascending prepared-test indices for each other rare class, fixed independently of prediction outcomes.
policies.local_trace: Compressed NPZ contains only prepared-test row indices, labels, logits, masks, margins and predictions. LOCAL ONLY; no feature vectors or raw traffic rows are saved.
policies.margin: Raw logits, not probabilities: true-Normal; true-max(other seen); max(seen attacks)-Normal. True-class decision margins are null until the class is seen.
policies.prediction: argmax(logits[:, seen_classes]) mapped back through the saved ordered seen_classes, exactly as the source evaluator. No task ID input and no new gating.
policies.probe_selection: Every prepared ID test row in an attack class with original training count <2000, in ascending prepared-test index order. This diagnostic roster is not a mechanism hyperparameter.
policies.research_limit: Bounded descriptive RQ2 diagnostic; not explanation drift, a new mechanism, or completion of RQ1/RQ3/overall research.
policies.scope: Existing task-end checkpoints only; CPU inference; no training or parameter search.
policies.source_selection: Replay and D2 paths/hashes are taken from the frozen Section25 analysis; no source substitution by score.
policies.test_role: Previously exposed test data are descriptive probes only, not tuning, model selection, independent confirmation or causal evidence.
policies.transitions: Only transitions whose true class was already seen at the previous checkpoint count as post-introduction changes; an introduction miss is not post-introduction forgetting.
policies.unseen: Future true classes are excluded from original checkpoint evaluation. Their extra probe predictions are labelled unseen_probe_only; no family/binary recall or valid true-class margin is claimed before introduction.
policies.verification: Reproduce every saved seen-class confusion matrix over its full original ID evaluation population; hash actual checkpoint payloads before CPU loading.
